妥妥苏奶娘的狂热粉嘛！（妥妥苏奶娘的狂热粉嘛！（第22页）裴相爷竟然主动在夸自己？紧接着就听裴相爷继续说道：“你们要真想替衡儿道谢，最感谢的就是咱们太平侯府的苏奶娘！”等等＝什么叫做咱们太平侯府？裴相爷不是裴府的吗？他不是还跟老侯爷不合吗？怎么突然就打破壁垒了？这裴府与太平侯府隔了好几好几条街呢！怎么就这么亲昵的咱们了？“人家苏奶娘不舍昼夜与孙府医来到裴府，光是这份恩情，你们两个就得好生记着！”裴望之，裴简之也听懵了。父亲大人，这份恩情不该是大哥大嫂谨记于心吗？虽说衡儿是他俩亲侄，但到底是大哥大嫂的亲儿啊！他们两兄弟就大可不必领个小小奶娘的情儿吧？很快两人又反应过来了，不对呀，衡儿能转好，那不是华院首跟孙府医的功劳吗？关一个太平侯府奶娘什么事？裴相爷捕抓到两人疑惑的眼神，神情肃穆，仿佛再说一件不得了的事情。“混账，你们两个敢质疑苏奶娘？真是无知小儿！闲饭没少吃，这该打听的是一件都不知道啊！苏奶娘！包治百哭的苏奶娘都没听说过？！！”裴望之、裴简之对视了一眼，咕噜噜摇了摇头，脸颊的肉像水波纹一样荡开。裴相爷可算是逮着教训两个儿子的机会了，把苏念禾那叫一个大夸特夸！比起元叙白、裴柔之来说过犹不及，文采斐然！苏念禾也算是开了眼了！什么是文人之首，河东裴氏当前掌门人的风采卓姿！论述起来亦如滔滔江水奔流不绝！听得她那叫一个目瞪口呆。论文学修养的重要性！霓虹色的虚拟显示屏疯狂跳跃起来，上面的赞誉值闪烁不停。赞誉值到账10000＋赞誉值到账10000＋赞誉值到账9500＋……苏念禾暗爽到想去银河里冲个浪！哇哦！这就是位列宰辅的威力吗？赞誉值都是以千以万起步的？那她可不得赚大发了？裴相爷口若悬河，两儿子瑟瑟发抖。他俩心里咯噔一声：完了，自己的耳朵可要遭殃喽！父亲大人最擅给人讲学，那还不得讲到地老天荒？还有那个苏奶娘，到底给父亲灌了什么迷魂汤？不对，是给这满屋子里的人都灌了什么迷魂汤，怎么一个个都跟打了鸡血似的？狂热成这个样子？这还是他们那个威仪有度、面色不改的相爷爹吗？好家伙，妥妥一个苏奶娘的狂热粉嘛！两人听了几耳朵，就匆匆找了由头给遁了。打算出府去躲几日。不就是衡儿退热了吗？至于这样？搞的跟他重生了似的。这哥俩正往外走，遇上了抱着小元宝回来的裴小妹——裴柔之。“二哥，三哥，你们脸色怎么这么难看？要去哪里？家里出什么事了？”裴望之、裴简之也不知道该怎么跟小妹说，摆了摆手，匆匆忙忙跑开了。裴柔之眉头紧锁，进门就听下人说衡儿病了，发热了好几日，请了不少大夫都束手无策。“不行，今日就是把嘴皮子磨破了，也要让父亲大人把苏奶娘给请过来！”

Chapter 144 I am a fan of Nanny Su (Page 1)
A huge fan of Nanny Su! (You are a fan of Nanny Su! (Page 22)) Mr. Pei actually took the initiative to praise himself? Then Mr. Pei continued to say: "If you really want to say thank you for Heng'er, the one you want to thank the most is our Taiping Marquis. Nanny Su from the mansion! "Wait a minute = what is our Taipinghou Mansion? Isn't Prime Minister Pei from the Pei Mansion? Isn't he still at odds with the old Marquis? Why did the barrier suddenly break? The Pei Mansion is separated from the Taiping Hou Mansion by several There are several streets! Why are we so close? "Nanny Su came to Pei's house day and night with Doctor Sun. You two have to remember this kindness!" Pei Wangzhi and Pei Jianzhi were also confused. Father, shouldn't the elder brother and sister-in-law keep this kindness in mind? Although Heng'er is their biological nephew, he is his biological son after all! There is no need for the two brothers to have a nanny. ? Soon the two of them realized that it was wrong. Isn't it the credit of the head of the Huayuan and the doctor of the Sun Mansion that Heng'er can get better? What does it have to do with the nanny of the Taipinghou Mansion? Mr. Pei caught the two people's puzzled eyes, looking solemn, as if they were talking about something outrageous. "Bastard, you two dare to question Nanny Su? You are so ignorant! You have nothing to eat, and you don't know anything about this! Nanny Su!" Nanny Su has never heard of it?!" Pei Wangzhi and Pei Jianzhi looked at each other, and the flesh on their cheeks spread like ripples. Mr. Pei took this opportunity to teach his two sons a lesson. Su Nianhe is a big boast! Compared to Yuan Xubai and Pei Rouzhi, Su Nianhe's literary talent is an eye-opener! The discussion was like a torrent of water! She was stunned. The neon-colored virtual display jumped crazily, and the praise value on it flashed. The value is 10,000 + the praise value is 9,500 +... Su Nianhe is so happy that he wants to go for a swim in the Milky Way! Wow! Is this the power of being ranked as the prime minister? Starting with tens of thousands? Then she can make a fortune? Mr. Pei is so eloquent that his two sons tremble in their hearts: It's over, their ears will suffer! Study, why don’t you talk about it for all time? And what kind of ecstasy soup did that nanny Su give to my father? No, what kind of ecstasy soup was given to all the people in this room? Why did they all look like they were given chicken blood? Are you so fanatical? Is this still their dignified and unchanging father? He is really a fan of Nanny Su! After hearing this for a few times, they hurriedly found an excuse to escape. I was going to hide out for a few days. Isn't it because Heng'er has recovered from his fever? It's as if he has been reborn. The two brothers were walking out and met Pei Rouzhi, who was coming back with little Yuanbao in his arms. "Third brother, why are you looking so ugly? Where are you going? What happened at home?" Pei Wangzhi and Pei Jianzhi didn't know what to say to their little sister, so they waved their hands and ran away. After locking the door, I heard from the servants that Heng'er was ill and had a fever for several days. Many doctors were called but they were unable to do anything. "No, I have to let my father invite Nanny Su here even if I have to wear my tongue today!"
